mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the magnetic stripes to moving plates was most worthwhile: it clarified that continents travel with plates rather than ploughing through stationary ocean floor.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final connection to habitats was useful but broad; it offered no concrete example of a species distribution.

surprise.text: The complementary roles of spreading and subduction explain how ocean floor can be recycled without Earth continually expanding.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though each decision had only one offered combination, so there was little meaningful choice.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see another concrete connection between geological evidence and living things, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
